washing.title: Washing
washing.card: Validated washing of vials, stoppers and components to remove particulates and endotoxin before sterilization.
washing.headline: Component washing that starts every batch clean.
washing.lede: Glass vials, stoppers and seals are washed with purified water and water for injection on validated cycles, then handed straight to sterilization.
caps: Automated vial washing
Rotary washers with alternating WFI and compressed-air jets clean the inside and outside of every vial.
Stopper and seal processing
Rubber closures are washed, siliconized if required, and bagged for steam sterilization.
Endotoxin control
Wash cycles are qualified to remove endotoxin and particulates, with rinse water sampled each run.
specBody: Washing runs in-line with depyrogenation, so clean vials never wait in open air.
We qualify each new component format with spiked particulate and endotoxin challenge studies.
deliverables: Washing batch record within your master record
Component qualification report for new formats

sterilizing.title: Sterilizing
sterilizing.card: Dry-heat depyrogenation, steam sterilization and VHP decontamination for components and equipment.
sterilizing.headline: Sterilization and depyrogenation you can audit.
sterilizing.lede: Washed vials pass through a dry-heat tunnel into the Grade A filling zone. Stoppers, tools and change parts are steam sterilized on validated loads.
caps: Dry-heat depyrogenation
A continuous tunnel delivers sterile, endotoxin-free vials directly into the isolator.
Steam sterilization
Autoclave cycles for stoppers, filling parts and garments, each with load maps and biological indicators.
VHP decontamination
Vaporized hydrogen peroxide cycles decontaminate isolators and material transfers.
specBody: Every load runs on a validated cycle with recorded temperature, pressure and time.
We run endotoxin challenge vials and biological indicators to confirm each cycle meets its target.
deliverables: Cycle printouts in your batch record

mixing.title: Mixing
mixing.card: GMP compounding and sterile filtration of solutions and suspensions from bench scale to production tanks.
mixing.headline: Compounding that keeps your formulation consistent.
mixing.lede: We weigh, dissolve and blend your formulation in jacketed single-use or stainless vessels, then sterile-filter it into the filling suite.
caps: Solution and suspension prep
Controlled-temperature mixing with in-process checks for pH, osmolality and concentration.
Sterile filtration
Redundant 0.2 µm filtration with pre- and post-use integrity testing.
Low-shear handling
Mixing profiles suited to proteins and other shear-sensitive actives.
specBody: Raw materials are released by our QC lab before dispensing.
Hold-time studies define how long the bulk can wait before filling.
deliverables: In-process test data and hold-time support

filling.title: Filling
filling.card: Isolator-based aseptic filling of vials with partial stoppering for lyophilization.
filling.headline: Aseptic filling, ready for the lyophilizer.
filling.lede: Our isolator line fills, weighs and partially stoppers vials in Grade A air, then loads them into the lyophilizer without opening the barrier.
caps: Isolator filling
A closed barrier separates operators from open product throughout filling.
100% checkweighing
In-line weighing adjusts fill pumps in real time to hold your target volume.
Automatic lyophilizer loading
Partially stoppered vials move by conveyor directly onto the lyophilizer shelves.
specBody: Peristaltic and rotary piston pumps cover viscous, sensitive and low-volume products.
Media fills qualify the line twice a year.
deliverables: Filling batch record with checkweight data
Media fill status for the line

lyophilization.title: Lyophilization
lyophilization.card: Cycle development, optimization and GMP lyophilization from pilot lots to commercial batches.
lyophilization.headline: Lyophilization is what we do best.
lyophilization.lede: We design cycles from your formulation's thermal data, scale them from pilot to production dryers, and run them under GMP with full process monitoring.
caps: Thermal characterization
Lyomicroscopy and DSC find your collapse and glass transition temperatures before any cycle is written.
Cycle development and optimization
We build a recipe that keeps product temperature below collapse, then shorten primary drying without risking the cake.
Scale-up and GMP manufacturing
Pilot and production dryers share controls and sensors, so a cycle transfers with predictable results.
specBody: Every dryer carries wireless product probes, capacitance and Pirani gauges, and pressure-rise testing to confirm the end of primary drying.
Controlled ice nucleation is available to make freezing uniform from vial to vial.
spec: Pilot 0.5 m², production 10 m² and 32 m²
Product probes, Pirani vs. CM, pressure rise
deliverables: Engineering and GMP batch records with full cycle data

capping.title: Capping
capping.card: Full stoppering inside the dryer, then aluminum crimp sealing with 100% container closure inspection.
capping.headline: Sealing that protects the cake you just dried.
capping.lede: Vials are fully stoppered inside the lyophilizer under controlled atmosphere, then crimp sealed and inspected before they leave the clean zone.
caps: In-chamber stoppering
Shelves press stoppers home at the end of the cycle, under nitrogen or partial vacuum.
Crimp sealing
Aluminum and flip-off seals applied with residual seal force monitoring.
Container closure integrity
Headspace and leak testing confirm each seal keeps moisture and oxygen out.
specBody: Capping runs in a Grade A air supply to keep sealed vials clean.
Rejected vials are segregated and reconciled against the batch count.
spec: Headspace O₂ and moisture, vacuum decay

labeling.title: Labeling
labeling.card: Vial labeling, serialization, cartoning and kit assembly, ready for clinical or commercial distribution.
labeling.headline: Labeled, serialized and ready to ship.
labeling.lede: We apply printed or variable-data labels, serialize to your market's rules, and pack units into cartons or kits for distribution.
caps: Vial labeling
Pressure-sensitive wrap labels with print-and-verify for lot and expiry data.
Serialization
2D DataMatrix codes and aggregation to meet DSCSA and EU FMD requirements.
Cartoning and kitting
Unit cartons, multi-component kits and clinical blinding where needed.
specBody: Vision systems check every label for presence, position and print quality.
Label stock is controlled and reconciled against each batch.

rnd.title: R&D
rnd.card: Formulation development, feasibility studies and stability programs that get your product ready to lyophilize.
rnd.headline: Formulation science before the first cycle.
rnd.lede: Our scientists screen excipients, build stable formulations and run the studies that tell you whether, and how, your product should be lyophilized.
caps: Formulation development
Excipient screening for bulking agents, cryoprotectants and buffers matched to your active.
Lyophilization feasibility
Small-scale lyophilization runs show cake quality and stability before you commit to scale.
Stability and analytics
ICH stability storage with in-house methods for potency, moisture and degradation.
specBody: Development data feeds straight into our manufacturing team, so nothing is lost in transfer.
We can also support tech transfer of methods you already have.
deliverables: Feasibility cycle data and cake images

synthesis.title: Custom Synthesis
synthesis.card: Synthesis of small molecules, peptides, conjugates and reagents to your specification, from milligrams to kilograms.
synthesis.headline: Custom synthesis for the active you need.
synthesis.lede: When your active ingredient or reagent isn't available off the shelf, our chemists make it to your specification and hand it directly to our formulation team.
caps: Route design and scale-up
Synthetic routes chosen for yield, purity and a path to larger scale.
Peptides and conjugates
Solid-phase peptide synthesis, labeling and conjugation for diagnostics and therapeutics.
Reagents and standards
Reference standards, substrates and specialty reagents with full characterization.
specBody: Every lot ships with a certificate of analysis and supporting spectra.
Material made here can move straight into formulation and lyophilization without a third-party transfer.
deliverables: Synthesized material with certificate of analysis
